pages.title: History to explore. Worlds to create.
pages.description: Discover SanguoSeason, Sanguo3D, Creators and Ming: historical and imagined strategy worlds from a small independent team.

pages.title: SanguoSeason — the classic, renewed
pages.description: SanguoSeason: the classic 三国春秋, renewed with its Gusu-inspired heritage. Introduction, reading, workshop notes and legacy downloads.

pages.title: Sanguo3D — a new Three Kingdoms world
pages.description: Sanguo3D is the development codename for a new 3D Three Kingdoms project. It is still in early development, and its final title has not been decided.

pages.title: Creators — a world of your making
pages.description: Creators is a culturally neutral, multilingual strategy game concept focused on player-led building in an imagined world.

pages.title: Ming — history before the world
pages.description: A longer-term late-Ming project: historical research first, with the potential to reuse Sanguo3D’s technical architecture.

pages.title: ZHSan — an independent companion branch
pages.description: The independently maintained SeasonRealms branch of Zhonghua Sanguozhi. A companion project, not a Season-owned game brand.

pages.title: A short introduction to the Three Kingdoms
pages.description: The historical setting behind Sanguo3D and SanguoSeason: Wei, Shu, Wu, and the difference between history and storytelling.

pages.title: A painted world, not a single style
pages.description: From the Gusu Prosperity painting to blue-green mountains: the visual roots of SanguoSeason and Sanguo3D.

pages.title: About this collection
pages.description: About Season Games, its four project directions, the independent ZHSan companion branch, and artwork credits.

classic.name: SanguoSeason
classic.tagline: A familiar world, renewed with care.
classic.summary: Return to SanguoSeason: painted cities, a wide strategic map, and the warmth of the Gusu scroll. A classic being renewed without leaving its past behind.
classic.image_alt: Warm-toned promotional composition from the original SanguoSeason website
classic.caption: Original game archive · Not a renewal screenshot
classic.reading_title: The scroll, the setting, and the game

new-sanguo.name: Sanguo3D
new-sanguo.summary: A new Three Kingdoms world in 3D, shaped by blue-green mountain landscapes. Passes, cities and rivers belong not only in the painting, but in your strategy.
new-sanguo.image_alt: Layered blue-green mountains, waterways and small settlements
new-sanguo.caption: Landscape reference · Not 3D gameplay

creators.name: Creators
creators.summary: A culturally neutral, multilingual counterpart to Sanguo3D. Similar strategic foundations, but an imagined setting and a focus on what players choose to build.
creators.image_alt: Abstract terrain contours and connected settlement shapes on a planning sheet
creators.caption: Site illustration · Not game artwork or gameplay

ming.name: Ming
ming.summary: A future late-Ming project, beginning with the historical groundwork it needs. Sanguo3D’s technical architecture can support it; the history must be studied on its own terms.
ming.image_alt: An editorial arrangement of research pages, river lines and a red archival-style seal
ming.caption: Research-themed site illustration · Not a historical document
ming.availability: No public build or release date
ming.reading_title: A reading room still to be assembled

zhsan.name: ZHSan
zhsan.summary: The SeasonRealms branch of Zhonghua Sanguozhi (中华三国志). Independently maintained as a companion project, with respect for the original team’s brand and community.
zhsan.caption: Zhonghua Sanguozhi · A separate project’s identity
zhsan.reading_title: Know which branch you are using
